name: Anthropic Lake Mariner

timeline.event: Land clearing begins for Building 1 (AKA CB3).

explain: Anthropic Lake Mariner is an operating AI data center in Barker, NY, owned by anthropic. Epoch AI estimates it draws 42 MW today and 441 MW when finished.
